app.name: InterviewIQ
app.subtitle: Junior to CTO & CEO | Free, Offline, Tailored to Company
app.newVersionDesc: Click refresh to get the latest features and improvements.

landing.heroTitle: From <1>junior developer</1> to <3>CTO & CEO</3> — interview prep that knows your target.
landing.heroDesc: InterviewIQ is the AI interviewer that tailors every question to your field, level and target company — or your pasted job description. Answer, get scored, follow the roadmap, and walk in ready.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to <1>walk in ready</1>
landing.featuresDesc: One coach for the whole ladder — from your first coding question to the CTO room.

tailored.title: Tailored sessions
tailored.body: Pick your level (junior → CEO), field and target company — or paste a job description — and get questions written for that exact role, with model answers and scoring key points.

mock.title: Mock interviews
mock.body: Full interview-mode rounds with per-question scoring, hints, category breakdowns and a study-next plan. Voice mode lets the interviewer speak while you answer aloud.

roadmap.title: Career roadmap
roadmap.body: Tell it where you want to be and by when. InterviewIQ builds a week-by-week plan, runs an optional skill-gap diagnostic, and reschedules as your real results come in.

tutor.title: AI tutor with citations
tutor.body: Ask anything about a topic. The tutor answers from your own knowledge base (PDFs, docs) with visible source citations — no hallucinated answers.

playground.title: Code playground
playground.body: Write and run code in multiple languages right in the browser, with hidden test cases that judge your solution the way a real interviewer would.

bank.title: Self-improving bank
bank.body: A curated question bank, spaced-repetition drill, deep-dive knowledge base — and a content engine that keeps adding fresh questions from real sources and your own misses.

step1.title: Pick your target
step1.body: Level, field, company — or paste the job description you're interviewing for.

step2.title: Get interviewed
step2.body: Answer tailored questions, get scored on key points, review model answers and AI feedback.

step3.title: Follow the roadmap
step3.body: Drill weak topics, track streaks and progress, and watch the roadmap adapt to your results.

landing.pricingDesc: Start free. Upgrade only when you want unlimited everything.
landing.freeDesc: Everything you need to start today.
landing.proDesc: Unlimited practice, AI coaching and voice rounds.

faqs.a1: Yes. The core experience — tailored questions, model answers, mock interviews, roadmap, drill and question bank — is free and works fully offline, with no account and no API key. Pro adds unlimited sessions, all company sets, voice mode and unlimited AI coaching.
faqs.q2: Does it cover every level, from junior to CTO and CEO?
faqs.a2: Yes. Choose junior, mid, senior, staff, principal, CTO or CEO — combined with your field and target company — and the session is built for that exact combination.
faqs.q3: Can I tailor questions to a specific company or job description?
faqs.a3: Yes. Pick from ~20 companies (or 'general'), or paste any job description and InterviewIQ generates questions around the role's actual requirements and keywords.
faqs.a4: Yes. InterviewIQ is an installable PWA. After the first load, everything works offline — sessions, history, streaks, drill and the question bank — and progress syncs to the cloud when you sign in.
faqs.q5: Do I need an API key for AI feedback?
faqs.a5: No. The built-in scoring engine works with zero setup. Add an OpenAI-compatible key in Settings when you want generative AI feedback, hints and the tutor.
